name: Six-plus hold 'em
summary: Short-deck Texas hold'em variant played with a 36-card deck where flushes beat full houses.
rules_text: Use a 36-card deck with all 2s through 5s removed. Same betting, blinds, and action as Texas hold'em: pre-flop, flop, turn, river with betting rounds. Each player gets two private hole cards, then five community cards are dealt face up. Players make the best five-card hand from any combination of seven. Aces play high and can complete the low straight A-6-7-8-9 and the high straight 10-J-Q-K-A. Hand rankings are modified: a flush beats a full house because flushes are rarer. In most versions a straight still beats three-of-a-kind, though some play with standard rankings.
